summary:
Fixing DeanOS Deployment & Exchange Email Parsers.

- Port Fix: Change service port from 9292 back to 8001 (user preference).
- Remote Git Fix: Provide a script to convert the non-git "it-inventory" folder on DeanOS into a proper Git clone.
- Email Fix: Verify Exchange connection settings and ensure APP_BASE_URL matches the server IP.
- CI/CD: Update deploy.ps1 to reflect Port 8001.
